comment: train-lora.py does NOT download klein: it looks the snapshot up in the HF cache and exits if it is absent. Native geometry is 320x576 unless an explicit --opt-width/--opt-height is passed.
label: FLUX.2-klein 320x576
requires: the FLUX.2-klein-4B snapshot in the model cache (hf download black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B --exclude flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors)
note: ~18 GB bundle. 'both' builds the bf16 and fp8 pair; fp8 needs SM 8.9+.
